detail: His Federal Supreme Court biography lists law studies in Bern and Bologna, a doctorate in 2007 and a habilitation in 2017, without naming the universities that awarded the doctorate and the habilitation. It also lists him as a titular professor at the University of Zurich.

qualification: Admission to the bar (Rechtsanwalt des Kantons Bern)
detail: Admitted as a lawyer in the canton of Bern in 2009, according to his Federal Supreme Court biography.
